items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: every time I’ve ever worked with Eddie Gomez, it’s not possible to work with Eddie without being aware of his 11 years with Bill Evans

ctx.x: And Eddie Gomez is someone you met early on.
I met Eddie in 1960 at the apartment I was living in with my first wife, and where I had my kids. My kids were born at North Moore Street, just below Canal.
